Until then this manifest is intentionally inert as merge-grade evidence; any PR citing it via `RC manifest path:` will fail the gate closed on approval_status, which is correct pre-soak behavior. CTO RULING 2026-07-28 (deferred-consolidated-soak): `soak_mode` above activates a distinct, narrower CI evidence path (`deferredConsolidatedSoakCoverage()` in scripts/ci/check-staging-evidence.ts) that lets an `included_prs[]` entry pass the Staging Soak Evidence Gate WITHOUT real soak evidence, on the explicit trade of "evidence before merge" for "evidence before DEPLOY": the gate's check summary states plainly, every time, that evidence is DEFERRED and NOT satisfied, and the check only passes at all when it can positively confirm `vars.DEPLOY_WORKER_PAUSED=true` is engaged on the live workflow run (services/worker/**-touching merges cannot reach prod while paused — see .github/workflows/deploy-worker.yml `deploy-gate` job and .github/workflows/agents.md "Deploy-worker pause gate"). This is NOT a substitute for the real 72h soak — it defers the soak from pre-merge to pre-deploy. `approval_status` stays the literal string "pending" for as long as `soak_mode` is set; do NOT flip it to "approved" while deferred mode is active — that combination is itself rejected by the gate (approved implies real evidence, which deferred mode by definition does not have). Once the real 72h soak (docs/release/72h-soak-runbook-2026-08.md) completes and matures, the correct sequence is: (1) remove `soak_mode` from this manifest, (2) fill in the real `environment`/`soak`/`migration_plan` blocks with actual evidence, (3) THEN flip `approval_status` to "approved" — restoring the normal (non-deferred) RC-manifest evidence path this gate has always enforced. Residual risk while deferred mode is active: `main` carries unsoaked T2/T3 worker/migration code for the duration of the soak window; any hotfix needed during that window must go through the same `deploy-gate` (`workflow_dispatch` to force an intentional deploy, or wait for the wave's soak + un-pause). _append_procedure: PURPOSE: this manifest is a living document from now (2026-07-28, PR wave still being opened) through 72h-soak completion. Follow this procedure every time a new sprint PR opens or a Mergify batch lands, per docs/release/wave-merge-choreography-2026-08.md.

1. NEW PR OPENS (Wave S / any lane): append one object to `included_prs[]` with number/head_sha/base_sha/risk_tier (compute via `npx tsx` importing `requiredTierFor` from scripts/ci/check-staging-evidence.ts, or run the CI job and read its tier note) /owner/title/ci_summary/rollback_note/migration_files/soak_coverage. Do NOT renumber or reorder existing entries — append only, so exact-head history stays auditable.

2. MERGIFY BATCH LANDS (~every 10 PRs per batch_size, ~4 checkpoints expected for a ~40-PR wave): append the new `main` tip SHA to BOTH `allowed_base_shas` and `covered_main_shas` (do not remove old SHAs — PRs still soaking against an older base need it covered). Re-point any now-stale `included_prs[].base_sha` entries only if that PR was rebased; otherwise leave its recorded base_sha as the head it was actually soaked against.

3. A migration PR is assigned a new NNNN per the RTE table (0361, 0367-0378 per docs/release/wave-merge-choreography-2026-08.md) — append its file to `migration_plan.order` in ascending numeric order and add its `migration_files` entry to that PR's included_prs object.

4. AT SOAK MATURITY (72h elapsed, all stop conditions clear, preflight clean_mirror, positive-control evidence captured per the 4-pillar standard): the release owner (Carson) fills `environment`, `soak.start/end/result/evidence_links`, `migration_plan.rollback_proof/reapply_proof`, flips `approval_status` to the literal string "approved", fills `approval_actor`/`approval_time`, and each PR body adds `RC manifest path: docs/staging/rc-manifests/rc-2026-08-launch-72h.json` under its own `## Staging Soak Evidence` / `Tier:` line.

5. If a PR is dropped from the wave (closed, deferred, or fails CI unrecoverably in-window), move its object from `included_prs[]` to `excluded_prs[]` with a one-line reason — do not silently delete it.
